findings.problem: The bare prompt "to look" also fits aussehen ("you look tired") and sehen ("sieh mal"), and the hint only rules out gucken.
findings.fix: hint: direct your eyes, as in look out the window; not gucken, sehen or aussehen

back.target: to look (direct your eyes); also to watch
back.example: I'm looking out of the window.

note: In Germany schauen is used more in the south and gucken more in the north, but both are understood everywhere, and Austria and Switzerland also say schauen, so leaving regional null is right.
